blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Public school classes in Talisay City will be suspended on Thursday, October 15, in observance of the annual fiesta of its patron saint, Sta. Teresa de Avila. Mayor Gerald Anthony “Samsam” Gullas Jr. announced the suspension in a social media post on Wednesday afternoon, October 14. Gullas said private schools in Talisay City may decide for themselves whether to suspend classes on Thursday’s fiesta.
